title: Initiative lifecycle spotlight and prioritization lab for monthly strategy sync
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Host a compact, decision-oriented monthly session that surfaces the true lifecycle status of active initiatives, accelerates prioritization decisions, and produces a single decision ledger that feeds the roadmap. Scope: 3-4 initiative "spotlights" (one slide each), a prioritization lab using a trade-off matrix (cost vs. latency vs. reliability vs. strategic value), and an actionable decision log with owners and due dates. Background: We regularly receive noisy signal across OKRs and project updates — this format aims to compress signal into concrete tradeoffs and explicit resource asks so leadership can reallocate capacity quickly. Deliverables: (1) Spotlight one-pagers for each initiative uploaded to Drive, (2) decision ledger with committed owners and dates, (3) concise resource reallocation proposal for Eng leadership, (4) updated OKR impact estimates attached to the ledger. Success metrics: 1) >=1 prioritization decision per session; 2) resource reallocation proposals reviewed by Eng leads within 5 business days; 3) OKR impact quantified for decisions (cost delta, median latency delta, reliability risk score). Stakeholders: Product leadership (Aisha Patel), Eng leads (Sofia Zhang, Omar Ruiz), Solutions Eng, Customer Success for high-impact customers, Analytics (for metric pulls). Data sources: Console initiative dashboards, canary rollout logs, benchmark harness (throughput/cost CSVs), and ENG-29841 perf telemetry. Meeting cadence & format: Monthly 45-minute session — 20m spotlights (5m each), 15m prioritization lab (matrix + facilitated tradeoffs), 10m decision capture + actions. Post-session: 24h decision ledger publication and assignment of follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: All spotlight one-pagers (<=1 slide each) uploaded to shared Drive folder
